tagline: Your personal finances, at a glance.

auth.title: Sign in to Yield
auth.description: Your spending, cards, and income, all in one place.
auth.denied: This account isn't allowed to sign in.

month.methodFromHere: Applies to this month and later ones; earlier months keep their method.
month.confirmDeletePurchase: Delete this purchase? Installment purchases are deleted from every month.
month.outstandingEmpty: Everything due this month is paid.

income.title: Income
income.empty: No income recorded this month yet.

add.exchangeHint: Moves money between your cash wallets at the rate you got. It isn't spending or income.
add.sourceExists: Already a source; this income goes to {name}.

settings.addWallet: Add a wallet in another currency
settings.confirmArchiveWallet: Archive this wallet? Its records keep it; it just won't be offered for new ones.
settings.currencyHint: Balance, needed per day, and averages are in this currency. Amounts in other currencies (like a dollar wallet) are shown on their own, never converted.
settings.incomeGroupsHint: Group sources to see their net income, like Rideshare (Uber, Didi) after Car spending.
settings.confirmArchiveGroup: Archive this group? Its sources keep their history and net; new sources can't join it.
settings.historyStartHint: Averages and typical daily spending skip earlier months, for when your first months only have some records (like card payments).
settings.cashOnHandHint: Cash, debit, and app balances, outside savings. It follows your income, cash spending, paid bills and statements, and savings from here; count it again whenever it drifts from your accounts.
settings.balanceGoalHint: What you want left over each month. Money moved into savings counts toward it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.confirmRemove: Remove this from your lists? Past records keep it.
settings.paymentDaysHint: The payment is due this many days after the statement closes.
settings.incomeRhythmHint: When your income arrives. Needed per payday and Income per payday count these paydays; you still record each income as it comes.
settings.rhythmAnchorHint: Any past or upcoming payday; the rest follow from it.
settings.rhythmDaysHint: Days of the month, separated by commas. A day past the month’s end falls on its last day.
settings.moneyHint: Cash on hand and credit cards
settings.planningHint: Balance goal, income rhythm, and summaries
settings.sourcesHint: Where income comes from, and net by group
settings.recurringIncomeHint: Income on a schedule, like a salary

errors.walletExists: There's already a wallet in this currency.
errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to two decimals.
errors.installments: Installments must be a whole number from 1 to 48, and only apply to cards.
errors.name: Add a name.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.coverMonths: Use a whole number of months from 1 to 24.
errors.recurringEnded: This recurring payment has ended and can't be edited.
errors.item: Choose an item or type a new one.
errors.itemExists: Another item already has this name. Merge them instead.
errors.paymentDays: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 60.
errors.payDays: Use days from 1 to 31, separated by commas (up to 8).

recurring.title: Recurring payments
recurring.description: Bills that repeat every month. They appear in each month to mark as paid; card-paid bills are paid with their card statement.
recurring.confirmStop: Stop this recurring payment? It stays in months already paid.
recurring.variableHint: Each month starts as an estimate from your recent bills; confirm the real amount when it arrives.
recurring.intervalHint: For bills every few months, start in a month that has a bill.
recurring.editHint: Changes apply from this month on; earlier months keep their amounts.
recurring.incomeDescription: Income that arrives on a schedule, like a salary. Each payday counts as expected in its month, and in the projected balance, until you mark it received.
recurring.firstPaydayHint: Any payday; the rest follow from it. A future date starts it then.
recurring.confirmStopIncome: Stop this recurring income? Income already received stays recorded.
recurring.incomeEditHint: Changes apply to paydays not received yet. A new schedule counts from today.

cards.title: Cards
cards.empty: Add your credit cards in Settings to track statements.

savings.title: Savings
savings.averageEmpty: Record a few months of spending to calculate your average.
savings.confirmArchiveGoal: Archive this goal? Its movements stay in your history.
savings.excludedNote: Categories set to not count in the average (like Extras) are left out.

manage.kindHintEVERYDAY: Day-to-day spending, like food or gas: counts in daily net, needed per day, and averages.
manage.kindHintBILLS: Regular bills, like rent: counts in averages, but not in daily figures.
manage.kindHintOCCASIONAL: One-off spending, like Extras: left out of averages and daily figures.
manage.builtInNameHint: Leave empty to keep the default name.
manage.confirmArchiveCategory: Archive this category? Its items and history stay; it just won't be offered for new entries.
manage.itemsDescription: Reusable expenses grouped by category. Moving an item moves its whole history.
manage.moveHint: Moving an item to another category moves all its history.
manage.confirmMerge: Merge “{source}” into “{target}”? All its entries and recurring payments move to “{target}” and “{source}” is removed.
manage.confirmArchiveItem: Archive this item? Its history stays; typing its name again brings it back.
manage.itemsEmpty: No items yet. They're created when you record an expense.

summary.headline: Headline
summary.statsHint: Shown two per row, in this order.
summary.empty: No stats on this card yet.
summary.hiddenHint: Some stats only show when they apply, like deductions with an income group or a group’s figures when you also have other income.

explain.aboutBalance: What the month leaves you: its income minus everything paid out this month (To pay).
explain.aboutTotalIncome: Everything received this month, and on how many days.
explain.aboutSpending: What you bought this month: purchases (card ones included), installments due this month, and recurring bills.
explain.aboutToPay: Money leaving this month: cash purchases and bills, card statements that close this month, and money moved into savings.
explain.aboutOutstanding: What's still unpaid of this month's cash bills and card statements.
explain.aboutNeededPerDay: Income needed on each day left this month to cover what's still to pay, plus a typical day's everyday spending.
explain.aboutNeededPerDayGoal: Income needed on each day left this month to reach your balance goal, plus a typical day's everyday spending.
explain.aboutDailyIncome: Income per day so far this month, counting every day, days off included.
explain.aboutDaysOff: Days you can still take off this month at your recent pace of work and still cover the month.
explain.aboutDaysOffGoal: Days you can still take off this month at your recent pace of work and still reach your balance goal.
explain.aboutProjectedBalance: Where the month's balance is headed if income and everyday spending keep their recent pace.
explain.aboutExpectedIncome: Recurring income not received yet this month.
explain.aboutNeededPerPayday: Income needed on each payday left this month to cover what's still to pay and everyday spending until the month ends.
explain.aboutNeededPerPaydayGoal: Income needed on each payday left this month to reach your balance goal, with everyday spending until the month ends.
explain.aboutIncomePerPayday: Average income per payday so far this month.
explain.aboutDeductions: Spending in the categories your income groups deduct: the costs of earning that income, like gas.
explain.aboutIncomeDayGross: Income per day worked: only days with income recorded count.
explain.aboutIncomeDayNet: Income after deductions, per day worked: only days with income recorded count.
explain.aboutCashOnHand: Money you have right now (cash, debit, and app balances, outside savings): your last count in Settings, moved by what you've recorded since.
explain.aboutGroupNet: {group}'s income after the spending it deducts.
explain.otherCurrencies: Amounts in other currencies are never converted or added in: {amounts}.
explain.noIncome: No income recorded this month yet.
explain.noGoal: Set a monthly balance goal in Settings to see how close you are to it.
explain.goalSavings: Money moved into savings counts toward the goal.
explain.spendingCards: Card purchases count here on the day you make them; their statement pays them later, in To pay.
explain.toPayCards: Card purchases count only through their statement, so nothing is counted twice.
explain.carried: Bills and statements from earlier months that are still unpaid count in their own month's totals, so they're shown beside this one, not in it.
explain.monthEnded: This month has ended, so there are no days left to count.
explain.everydayNote: Everyday spending per day is your purchases in everyday categories over the last {days} days, divided by them. Recurring bills and installments of earlier purchases aren't included.
explain.everydaySoFarNote: Everyday spending counts purchases in everyday categories, without recurring bills or installments of earlier purchases.
explain.breakEvenPerDay: Without the goal, {amount} a day covers the month.
explain.breakEvenPerPayday: Without the goal, {amount} per payday covers the month.
explain.covered: It's zero once the month is covered.
explain.dailyTarget: Green once it reaches the day's target of {amount} (Needed per day).
explain.paydayTarget: Green once it reaches the payday's target of {amount} (Needed per payday).
explain.daysOffPace: Your recent pace: {workDays} days worked in the last {days} days, each leaving {amount} after the costs of working (spending in the categories your income groups deduct, like gas).
explain.livingNote: Living costs are everyday spending per day without those categories, since a day off doesn't spend them.
explain.daysOffBreakEvenNote: Without the goal, {count} days off still cover the month.
explain.moreWorkThanDays: More work days are needed than there are days left, so none are off.
explain.daysOffNoPace: Shown once there's income in the last {days} days and a day worked earns more than it costs.
explain.currentMonthOnly: Only counted for the current month.
explain.paceNote: The recent pace is your income over the last {days} days divided by all of them, days off included. Recurring income is left out, since it's expected instead.
explain.expectedNote: A payday stays expected until you mark it received in the month view.
explain.noPaydaysLeft: No paydays are left this month, so the whole amount shows.
explain.rhythmNote: Paydays follow your income rhythm in Settings.
explain.beforeFirstPayday: Shown after the month's first payday.
explain.perDayWorked: Days without income aren't counted, unlike Daily income, which counts every day so far.
explain.cashNotCounted: Count what you have in Settings to start tracking it.
explain.cashCards: Card purchases leave it only when their statement is paid, and bills still pending aren't taken out.
